newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - CZECH REPUBLIC - JAN 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - CZECH REPUBLIC - JAN 28.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - At the beginning of March, a first 100 listed shares will be taken off the open market, and by the end of the first half of the year, another 300 will be taken off in monthly intervals.

- Teachers requesting an increase in wages will begin a chain strike today in schools in Brno and the districts of Nachod, Blansko, and Znojmo. Education Minister Ivan Pilip insists that fewer schools will be involved in the strike than union members have stated.

LIDOVE NOVINY - Lockheed Martin, one of many companies seriously interested in making a capital investment into Aero Vodochody (AV), is considering entering AV in a joint venture with a Czech company. According to vice president, Richard Stevens, there are many possible partners, and a final decision has yet to be made.

MLADA FRONTA DNES - In an unplanned meeting yesterday, the council of the Association of Hospitals, made up of more than 60 of the largest hospitals in the country, requested that the Health Ministry announce a crisis situation in health services due to debts which cannot be paid.

- Many economists are unhappy with the inefficiency of commercial courts. There have already been a few cases on the capital market where before the court has come to a decision on whether to block accounts in the Security Centre, shares were lost when they should have been preserved for the true owner.

PRAVO - Chairman of Parliament and head of the Social Democrats (CSSD) Milos Zeman began his two day visit to Germany yesterday with a meeting with German President Roman Herzog in Berlin. Zeman considered Herzog's response to his proposal for an accompanying document to the Czech-German Declaration as favourable.

- The foreign trade deficit reached 160.3 billion crowns last year, which is an increase of 60 percent over 1995. The Czech Statistical Bureau which provided the information believes that the increase is caused by a stagnation in imports.
